summary: Recent updates to the WebRTC web API, particularly in the RTCPeerConnection area, have introduced several enhancements that improve how video calls and real-time communications function. Notably, the implementation of the **RTCIceTransport selected candidate pair API** allows developers to better manage network connections during calls, ensuring smoother communication even in challenging network conditions. Additionally, the changes to RTP (Real-time Transport Protocol) parameters, including improved reporting on outbound statistics and better codec management, enhance the reliability and quality of media being transmitted, making for a more robust user experience while using applications that rely on WebRTC technology. Other improvements, such as streamlined error handling for DTLS (Datagram Transport Layer Security) and optimized memory management, contribute to the overall performance and stability of these real-time applications.
